title: How well does ChatGPT create resume bullets? ✍️
description:
If you have the first draft of your resume done, you can use AI to make your resume achievements even stronger. Just type this prompt into ChatGPT. It can help you to quantify your achievements and make them more impactful: “I was in charge of [PRIMARY JOB TASK] at my last job. How can I rephrase this achievement to start with a strong action verb? Please include examples of quantifiable metrics.” Then take the results back to the Teal Resume Builder to save them all the one place, edit them for accuracy and add any missing metrics. #resumebuilder #resumetips #resumetok
